attributes.name: actor_beside_or_behind_partner
attributes.text: One person stands beside or behind the other, not face to face.
attributes.definition: The actor is positioned at the side or back of the partner during the main phase, rather than facing them.

attributes.name: distance_decreases
attributes.text: The two people move closer together.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two torsos shrinks clearly during the action.

attributes.name: distance_increases
attributes.text: The two people end farther apart than they started.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two torsos grows clearly during the action, by walking away or the partner stepping back.

attributes.name: one_actor_one_reactor
attributes.text: One person acts while the other only responds or stays still.
attributes.definition: The two people have different roles: one initiates the main motion and the other receives it or reacts afterward.

attributes.name: mirrored_roles
attributes.text: Both people make the same movement at the same time.
attributes.definition: The two skeletons perform matching motions simultaneously, as mirror images of each other.

attributes.name: partner_recoils
attributes.text: The partner's body jerks or leans away from the actor.
attributes.definition: At the moment of the actor's movement, the partner's head or torso moves back or turns away suddenly.

attributes.name: partner_raises_arms_to_block
attributes.text: The partner lifts the arms in front of the head or body.
attributes.definition: The partner raises one or both arms in front of the head or chest as a guard in response to the actor.

attributes.name: contact_partner_upper_body
attributes.text: The actor's hand touches the partner's head, shoulders or chest.
attributes.definition: The actor's hand reaches the partner's upper body (head, shoulder, chest or upper back).

attributes.name: contact_partner_lower_body
attributes.text: The actor touches the partner's hip, legs or feet.
attributes.definition: The actor's hand or foot reaches the partner's body at hip level or below.

attributes.name: hands_meet_between
attributes.text: Hands of both people meet in the space between them.
attributes.definition: A hand of each person reaches forward so the two hands touch or nearly touch midway between the two bodies.

attributes.name: no_contact_at_distance
attributes.text: The two people stay apart and never touch.
attributes.definition: Throughout the action no joint of one person comes into contact with the other person.

attributes.name: move_together_same_direction
attributes.text: Both people walk in the same direction together.
attributes.definition: Both skeletons translate across the floor in the same direction at a similar speed.

attributes.name: sustained_body_contact
attributes.text: The two people stay in contact for a long time.
attributes.definition: Contact between the two bodies is held for much of the action rather than a brief touch.
